legend: You have a string s$$$s$$$ consisting of lowercase letters of the Latin alphabet.
You need to split this string into substrings according to the following requirements:
in each substring, the first character is equal to the last character;
each substring contains at least two characters;
each character of the string s$$$s$$$ belongs to exactly one of these substrings.
Therefore, if we concatenate all the resulting substrings in the same order, we'll get the original string s$$$s$$$.
A substring of the string s$$$s$$$ is a non-empty sequence of consecutive letters of the string s$$$s$$$.
For example, the string aadddzxxz can be split into substrings aa, ddd and zxxz.
Find the maximum number of substrings that the string s$$$s$$$ can be split into, and also the sizes of each of these substrings. If the string s$$$s$$$ cannot be split as described, report it.
input: The first line contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤4⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 4 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the length of the string s$$$s$$$.
The second line contains a string s$$$s$$$ of length n$$$n$$$ consisting of lowercase letters of the Latin alphabet.
output: If the string cannot be split into substrings of greater than one length that start and end with the same letter, print −1$$$-1$$$.

Otherwise, in the first line, print k$$$k$$$ — the maximum number of substrings that the string s$$$s$$$ can be split into. In the second line, print k$$$k$$$ integers — the sizes of substrings that the string s$$$s$$$ can be split into, in order from left to right. The sum of the output k$$$k$$$ numbers must be equal to n$$$n$$$.
note: In the first example, the string can be split into two substrings of length two, each of which starts and ends with the letter a.
In the second example, the string can be split into three substrings abcbca, ccbbc and abca.

legend.ai: 给定一个字符串 s$$$s$$$，它由拉丁字母表中的小写字母组成。
你需要根据以下要求将该字符串划分成若干子串：
在每个子串中，第一个字符与最后一个字符相同；
每个子串至少包含两个字符；
字符串 s$$$s$$$ 中的每个字符恰好属于其中一个子串。
因此，如果我们按照相同的顺序将所有得到的子串拼接起来，就会得到原字符串 s$$$s$$$。
字符串 s$$$s$$$ 的子串是字符串 s$$$s$$$ 中由连续字母组成的非空序列。
例如，字符串 aadddzxxz 可以拆分为子串 aa、ddd 和 zxxz。
求字符串 s$$$s$$$ 最多可以拆分成多少个子串，以及每个子串的长度。如果字符串 s$$$s$$$ 无法按上述方式拆分，则报告这一情况。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤4⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 4 \cdot 10^5$$$)——字符串 s$$$s$$$ 的长度。
第二行包含一个字符串 s$$$s$$$，其长度为 n$$$n$$$，由小写拉丁字母组成。

output.ai: 如果无法将该字符串拆分成若干个长度大于 1 且首尾字母相同的子串，则输出 −1$$$-1$$$。
否则，第一行输出 k$$$k$$$——字符串 s$$$s$$$ 最多可以拆分成的子串数量。第二行按从左到右的顺序输出 k$$$k$$$ 个整数，表示字符串 s$$$s$$$ 可以拆分成的各子串的长度。输出的 k$$$k$$$ 个数之和必须等于 n$$$n$$$。

note.ai: 在第一个示例中，字符串可以被分割成两个长度为 2 的子串，并且每个子串都以字母 a 开头和结尾。
在第二个示例中，字符串可以被分割成三个子串 abcbca、ccbbc 和 abca。
